fact: On 5 April 2023 the ICT ministers of six ECOWAS states including The Gambia signed an MoU on the Amilcar Cabral submarine cable, and The Gambia became Vice-Chair of its Ministerial Steering Committee.
title: Six ECOWAS Member States sign a Memorandum of Understanding in the presence of the ECOWAS Commission for the development of the Amilcar Cabral submarine telecommunications cable project
